title: narcissus linnaeanus subsp. ganymedoides
intro: Narcissus linnaeanus subsp. ganymedoides, commonly known as the Ganymede Daffodil, is a subspecies of the N. linnaeanus plant, characterized by its trumpet-shaped flowers and slender foliage. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to offer various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, alleviate anxiety and stress, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus linnaeanus subsp. ganymedoides include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
